typed_core.name: document_title
typed_core.why: identity/classification — human review

typed_core.name: insurance_carrier
typed_core.why: identity/source — who issued the policy (CORE)

typed_core.name: issuer_name
typed_core.why: disambiguator — administrator/issuer when different from the underwriting carrier

typed_core.name: policy_owner_name
typed_core.why: identity — whose asset this is; attaches to borrower (flattened from policy_owner_names)

typed_core.name: policy_owner_name_2
typed_core.why: identity — joint owner

typed_core.name: insured_name
typed_core.why: identity/disambiguator — the insured may differ from the owner; matters for asset attribution (flattened from insured_names)
typed_core.prompt_hint: Owner ≠ insured ≠ beneficiary — capture each in its own field; the owner controls the asset, the insured's death triggers the benefit

typed_core.name: policy_number_masked
typed_core.why: PII (restricted) — policy identifier; grouping key. Needs _PII_FIELDS registration (pre_masked true)

typed_core.name: policy_type
typed_core.why: identity/classification; term vs whole/universal — term has no cash value
typed_core.prompt_hint: Term life has no cash/surrender value — do not fabricate a value figure for a term policy; leave null

typed_core.name: policy_status
typed_core.why: processor; in-force vs lapsed governs whether it counts

typed_core.name: policy_effective_date
typed_core.why: identity — when coverage began (CORE)

typed_core.name: policy_issue_date
typed_core.why: disambiguator — issue vs effective date reconciliation

typed_core.name: face_amount_or_death_benefit
typed_core.why: processor — headline coverage amount

typed_core.name: cash_surrender_value
typed_core.why: processor — the liquid asset value; likely future reserves rule

typed_core.name: policy_loan_balance
typed_core.why: disambiguator — reduces net value; must sit beside cash value

typed_core.name: net_cash_value
typed_core.why: processor — the usable asset figure (cash value minus loans); reserves consumer
typed_core.prompt_hint: Net cash value = cash surrender value − outstanding policy loan balance; capture the stated components, do not compute

typed_core.name: premium_amount
typed_core.why: processor — recurring obligation; DTI-adjacent

typed_core.name: premium_frequency
typed_core.why: disambiguator — annualizes the premium

typed_core.name: premium_paid_through_date
typed_core.why: processor — currency of the policy; supports in-force claim

typed_core.name: lapse_or_expiration_date
typed_core.why: processor — when coverage ends; term-policy validity through closing

typed_core.name: assignment_or_collateral_interest
typed_core.why: processor — whether the policy is pledged/assigned as collateral

typed_core.name: surrender_or_withdrawal_restrictions
typed_core.why: disambiguator — whether the cash value is actually accessible

typed_core.name: policy_statement_date
typed_core.why: identity/recency — as-of date of the value figures

rejected.name: form_number, form_revision_date
rejected.reason: policy form numbers vary; no consumer

rejected.name: property_address, loan_number, account_case_reference_number
rejected.reason: not on a life policy; no consumer

rejected.name: signature_blocks, notary_block
rejected.reason: a policy is issued, not executed by the borrower

encoding_variations: policy_type (enum, null values): 'Term', 'Whole Life', 'Universal Life', 'Variable' — term policies have no cash surrender value; the type disambiguates whether the value fields should be non-null.

Value stated as 'Cash Value', 'Cash Surrender Value', 'Net Surrender Value', or 'Account Value' — cash_surrender_value, policy_loan_balance, and net_cash_value must be kept distinct; net = cash value − outstanding policy loans.
premium_frequency (enum, null): 'monthly', 'annual', 'quarterly' — required to annualize premium_amount.

open_questions.q: Reserves consumer. net_cash_value / cash_surrender_value are typed on the expectation that a reserves rule will read them.
open_questions.recommendation: confirm the intended snapshot_path so the field name matches the future rule
add to _PII_FIELDS (pre_masked true) before this schema ships, or the value lands unmasked in the catch-all
flattened to two scalars each; revisit as person[] only if a rule must address a third owner/insured

notes: No rules in the packet → no rule floor. A life insurance policy enters a mortgage file as an asset (cash surrender / net cash value used for reserves) or a collateral assignment. The typed core captures the identity, the in-force status, and the liquid-value figures; every field is justified by identity, PII, or processor review (a reserves rule reading net cash value is the obvious future consumer).

policy_number_masked is restricted; needs _PII_FIELDS registration, pre_masked true (extractor emits last-4). Not in the current 7-field registry — flag for registration. Leaving it to the catch-all would store the full policy number unmasked.
policy_owner_name / insured_name are personal names — standard-sensitivity, retained as typed identity fields (not _PII_FIELDS entries, consistent with how borrower names are handled elsewhere).
Money stays a string in value and is coerced to Decimal on read.
